findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document authorization
findings.body: When a user's tenant differs from the document's tenant, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` unconditionally. This removes the existing authorization boundary and permits cross-tenant document access wherever this exported check guards reads.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in the document read check
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now returns `true` when `userTenant !== documentTenant`, allowing users to pass authorization checks for documents belonging to another tenant.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document authorization
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any caller passing different `userTenant` and `documentTenant` values receives `true`, allowing cross-tenant document disclosure wherever this exported authorization check guards reads.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
